model_output.verdict: An inpatient pharmacy technician with sterile compounding, training, and measurable cabinet-restocking work.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for inpatient pharmacy work: you name the doses, nursing units, and technicians you trained! A recruiter can see both your day-to-day work and where you improved stock availability.

The cabinet-restocking line is a great model because it names the job, the six units, and the change in weekly stockout reports. Your California license and sterile compounding certification are easy to find. The separate duties section does make a recruiter match each line back to its job.

Put the duties directly under their roles, then explain what you meant by verifying prescriptions in the retail job. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back on its own; how competitive a particular opening is will also matter.
